name: Cairo & Giza
tagline: Pyramids, museum treasures and old streets
summary: Plan Giza and its museums as a dedicated western-city day, then explore historic Cairo separately. Road traffic makes short-looking map distances misleading.
seasonNote: Cooler months suit exposed monuments; summer heat is serious. Check current local conditions before excursions.
arrival: Arrange a reputable airport transfer or use official transport options; allow generous time for Cairo traffic.
gettingAround: Use the metro for suitable city legs and reputable cars or a guide for dispersed monuments.
cashTip: Keep small EGP notes for small purchases and agreed tips; many major sites use card payment. Confirm all inclusions before paying.
foodTip: Try koshari, taameya and Egyptian breakfast dishes; choose busy established venues and drink safe water.
buyTip: Look for textiles, brasswork and clearly labelled food gifts; bargain politely and avoid antiquities.
baseArea: Zamalek or a central hotel; Giza if pyramids are the priority

connections.note: Approximate airborne time; overnight rail is another option but needs a separate schedule and ticket check.
